memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Booking for initial consultation with Dr Priya Natarajan (D03) for chronic kidney disease review. Appointment set for 2025-04-15 at 10:30 AM. Patient advised to bring recent medication list and any lab reports.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Initial assessment for chronic kidney disease.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports fatigue and mild ankle swelling over past month.
EXAMINATION: BP 138/86 mmHg, weight 68 kg, height 1.58 m, BMI 27.2 (obese). JVP not raised, lungs clear, abdomen soft, no edema.
IMPRESSION: Chronic kidney disease stage 3a, likely hypertensive nephropathy. Fasting lipid profile and fasting blood sugar ordered; results pending. Hb 11.8 g/dL, serum creatinine 1.4 mg/dL, eGFR 52 mL/min/1.73m2, urine ACR 85 mg/g.
ARRANGEMENTS: Start telmisartan 40 mg OD, dapagliflozin 10 mg OD, furosemide 20 mg OD, sodium bicarbonate 500 mg BD. Advise low‑salt diet, limit protein to 0.8 g/kg/day, regular walking 30 mins daily. Influenza vaccine offered; patient declined today. Return if: chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, blood in stools, sudden decrease in urine output, severe flank pain.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Messaged via clinic app: Noticed increased swelling in feet after long work shifts, feeling more tired. No new meds. Asked if I should increase furosemide.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Follow‑up for chronic kidney disease with worsening edema.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Increased ankle swelling and fatigue over past 4 weeks.
EXAMINATION: BP 142/90 mmHg, weight 70 kg, BMI 28.0 (obese). Mild pitting edema up to mid‑calf, lungs clear.
IMPRESSION: Fluid overload likely due to inadequate diuretic control. Labs: creatinine 1.5 mg/dL, eGFR 48, Hb 11.5 g/dL, urine ACR 92 mg/g.
ARRANGEMENTS: Increase furosemide to 40 mg OD. Continue telmisartan, dapagliflozin, sodium bicarbonate. Reinforce fluid restriction 1.5 L/day, elevate legs. Influenza vaccine not due yet. Return if: chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, blood in stools, sudden weight gain >2 kg in 3 days, severe dyspnea.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Renal ultrasound: Both kidneys normal size, mild increased echogenicity suggestive of chronic parenchymal change. No obstruction or stones.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Review after diuretic adjustment and ultrasound.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Swelling improved, occasional mild fatigue.
EXAMINATION: BP 136/84 mmHg, weight 67 kg, BMI 26.8 (obese). No edema, lungs clear.
IMPRESSION: Better volume control. CKD stable; creatinine 1.4 mg/dL, eGFR 52, Hb 12.0 g/dL, urine ACR 78 mg/g. Influenza vaccine offered and given today 2025-11-20.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue current meds. Advise maintain low‑salt diet, regular activity, monitor weight. Return if: chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, blood in stools, sudden decrease in urine output, severe flank pain.

memories.author: D03
